summary: Redwire Corp filed an ATM prospectus supplement to sell up to $500 million of common stock at-the-market via multiple agents. The filing replaces a prior May 2026 facility from which $350 million was already sold. Shares trade on NYSE at $18.57. Agents earn up to 3% commission. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation event.
